status.ok: No violations of the modeling rules.

issue.multiple-process-objects: Only one data object “process” is allowed per process. Also found: “{{element}}”.
issue.reference-without-state: “{{reference}}” points to the data object “process” but has no status. A status is required there.
issue.start-event-state: “{{element}}” is a start event and sets a status. The initial status is set by the first activity.
issue.unknown-state: The status “{{state}}” is not in the catalog.
issue.label-state-mismatch: The label says “{{label}}”, the dataState is “{{state}}”. “{{state}}” applies.
issue.state-only-in-label: The status “{{state}}” is only in the label, not a dataState.
issue.input-state-never-set: “{{element}}” documents the status “{{state}}”, which no step sets.
issue.state-key-conflict: The key “{{key}}” stands for “{{state}}” here and for “{{other}}” elsewhere.
issue.raci-missing-responsible: “{{element}}” has no R. Every user task needs exactly one, on the task or through its swimlane.
issue.raci-multiple-responsible: “{{element}}” has more than one R: {{assignees}}. Exactly one is allowed.
issue.multi-instance-single-responsible: “{{element}}” is a multi-instance task and needs at least two R.
issue.raci-multiple-accountable: “{{element}}” has more than one A: {{assignees}}. At most one is allowed.
issue.lane-without-role: “{{element}}” has no assignment. Every lane and every pool without lanes needs a role or group or a dynamic assignment such as field(…) or firstOf(…).
issue.task-without-service: The task “{{element}}” has no IT service. User and service tasks need at least one.
issue.flow-without-condition: The path “{{flow}}” after “{{element}}” has no condition. After a split every path except the default flow needs one, otherwise an engine always takes the first.
issue.conditional-flows-without-default: “{{element}}” has only conditional paths. Without a default flow the process stops if no condition applies.
issue.unknown-result-condition: The path “{{flow}}” branches on the result “{{state}}”, which the task before it cannot set.
issue.either-or-at-task: “{{element}}” has a conditional path and a default flow. An either-or belongs in an exclusive gateway; conditional paths on a task only for “additionally, if …” next to the normal path.
issue.result-condition-at-task: The path “{{flow}}” branches directly at “{{element}}” on the result. Branching on a person's result uses an exclusive gateway.
issue.rule-kind-not-allowed: “{{element}}” is not completed by a person and can therefore only have start and follow-up actions, not “{{kind}}”.
issue.script-task-with-script: The script task “{{element}}” contains script text. A script task refers to an action and contains no code of its own.
issue.script-task-without-action: The script task “{{element}}” names no internal action. In the model it needs the attribute “internalAction” with the action type, e.g. log_entry.
issue.internal-action-not-on-script-task: “{{element}}” names an internal action but is not a script task. Internal actions exist only on script tasks.
issue.multiple-actions: “{{element}}” has several actions. An activity has at most one action.
issue.invalid-planning-value: The planning value “{{value}}” ({{attribute}}) at “{{element}}” cannot be read.
issue.gateway-without-probabilities: Not every outgoing flow of “{{element}}” has a probability; cycle time and staffing calculations stay incomplete.
issue.boundary-without-probability: The boundary event “{{element}}” has no probability on its outgoing flow; the calculation assumes it never occurs.
issue.probabilities-not-100: The probabilities of the outgoing flows of “{{element}}” add up to {{sum}} %, not 100 %.
issue.accountable-without-effort: “{{element}}” has an A but no effort for it. If the approval is modelled as its own task, enter 0 here.
issue.choice-without-name: The path “{{flow}}” is a choice of the assignee but has no name. The name is the text of the choice.
issue.choice-not-after-user-task: The path “{{flow}}” is a choice of the assignee. A choice is only possible at an exclusive gateway directly after a user task.
issue.choice-mixed: At the gateway “{{element}}”, the assignee’s choice is mixed with results of “{{task}}” or with field conditions. A task has either results or a choice.
issue.unknown-choice-condition: The path “{{flow}}” asks for the choice “{{choice}}”. A path with a choice always asks for its own ID.
issue.raci-unknown-field: “{{element}}”: the field {{field}} is not in the field list.
issue.multiple-none-start-events: “{{element}}” is another start event without a trigger. A process has only one (“{{first}}”); further paths start with a message start event.
issue.service-task-without-action: The automated task “{{element}}” has no action. To be executed it needs an IT service with an action (bestadd:actionRef) the system runs.

panel.name: Name ({{language}})
panel.modelLanguageDescription: Names and descriptions in the diagram are in this language.
panel.statusDescription: From the catalog. The ID appears in square brackets in the name.
panel.statusOnlyProcess: Only the data object “{{name}}” has a status. This data object is documentation only.
panel.dataObjectIdDescription: The same for all references to this data object. The ID under “General” belongs to the individual reference.
panel.statusDescriptionFree: Pick a status used in the model or type a new one. It appears in square brackets in the name.
panel.conditionResultDescription: This path is taken when the previous task is completed with this result.
panel.conditionExpressionDescription: Generated from the result. For field values by hand, e.g. ${amount > 10000}.
panel.conditionDefault: Default flow: taken when no other condition applies; it has no condition itself.
panel.conditionNoResults: The previous task sets no status. Without a result only a custom expression can be entered.
panel.rulesDescriptionHint: What is checked or done at the transition, in words.
panel.rulesOnlyActions: Nobody completes this task; it only has start and follow-up actions.
panel.timingEffortHint: Working time for one run, e.g. 30, 1h30m or 2d (working days). Basis for staffing.
panel.timingAccountableHint: Effort for the decision or approval. 0 if the approval is modelled as its own task.
panel.timingDurationHint: From being ready to completion including waiting time, in working time. Empty = same as the effort of R.
panel.timingWaitingHint: Expected time until the event occurs, in working time.
panel.timingInstancesHint: Only needed if the number does not follow from the number of R.
panel.timingProbabilityHint: How often this path is taken. At an exclusive gateway all outgoing flows add up to 100 %.
panel.timingBoundaryProbabilityHint: How often this event occurs per execution of the activity.
panel.calcComplete: All required planning values are present.
panel.calcIncomplete: Incomplete: the calculation uses what is there.
panel.calcNone: No planning values yet. Enter effort and duration at the tasks.
panel.calcHint: In working time; a working day has {{hours}} h. The cycle time comes from {{runs}} simulated runs.
panel.conditionChoiceDescription: The assignee of the task before picks this path on completion. The name of the path is the text of the choice; the status does not change.
panel.resultLabelDescription: Text the assignee sees for this result on completion, e.g. “Send back”. Empty: name of the status.

gateway.person: Decision by a person (result of the previous task)
gateway.choice: Choice of the assignee (names of the paths)

raci.title: Responsibilities (RACI)
raci.legend: R = responsible, A = accountable, C = consulted, I = informed
raci.fromLane: Comes from the swimlane. Change it via the role/group of the lane.

lane.title: Role/group
lane.description: From the catalog or typed in. Is R for all tasks on the lane. Dynamic assignments work too: field(…), firstOf(field(coach), field(responsible_person)) or approvalChain(…); the lane name is then free.
lane.poolDescription: From the catalog or typed freely. It is R for all tasks as long as the pool has no lanes.
lane.poolHasLanes: The pool has lanes. R always comes from the lane of the task.
lane.placeholder: Search or type a role or group, or type firstOf(…) …

picker.placeholder: Search or type a role or group …

profileHint.document: For diagrams that only document, for example from bpmn.io: tasks need no R, lanes no role and paths after a split no condition.
profileHint.complete: All checks. Every user task needs an R, every lane a role or group, every path after a split a condition.
profileHint.custom: Individual checks are switched on or off.

rule.multiple-process-objects: Only one data object “process” per process
rule.unknown-state: Status must be in the catalog (catalog only)
rule.state-only-in-label: Status is also stored as dataState
rule.state-key-conflict: A key stands for one status only
rule.raci-missing-responsible: Every user task has exactly one R
rule.raci-multiple-responsible: At most one R per task (except multi-instance)
rule.multi-instance-single-responsible: Multi-instance tasks have at least two R
rule.raci-multiple-accountable: At most one A per task
rule.raci-unknown-assignee: Roles and groups must be in the catalog (catalog only)
rule.lane-without-role: Every lane has a role or group
rule.task-without-service: Every user and service task has an IT service
rule.flow-without-condition: After a split every path has a condition (except the default flow)
rule.conditional-flows-without-default: Tasks with only conditional paths have a default flow
rule.unknown-result-condition: Conditions only name results the previous task sets
rule.either-or-at-task: Either-or with a gateway, not directly at the task
rule.result-condition-at-task: Branch on a person's result with a gateway
rule.rule-kind-not-allowed: Tasks without a person only have start and follow-up actions
rule.script-task-with-script: Script tasks contain no script text
rule.raci-unknown-field: Fields in field(…) are in the field list (only with a field list)
rule.multiple-none-start-events: Only one start event without a trigger per process
rule.multiple-actions: At most one action per activity
rule.script-task-without-action: Script tasks name an internal action (internalAction)
rule.internal-action-not-on-script-task: Internal actions only on script tasks
rule.choice-without-name: Paths chosen by the assignee have a name
rule.choice-not-after-user-task: Choice of the assignee only at an exclusive gateway directly after a user task
rule.choice-mixed: Do not mix the assignee’s choice with results or field conditions
rule.unknown-choice-condition: A path with a choice asks for its own ID
rule.invalid-planning-value: Planning values can be read (only with planning values)
rule.gateway-without-probabilities: Every outgoing flow of a gateway has a probability (only with planning values)
rule.probabilities-not-100: Probabilities at an either-or gateway add up to 100 % (only with planning values)
rule.boundary-without-probability: Boundary events have a probability (only with planning values)
rule.accountable-without-effort: Tasks with an A have an effort for the A (only with planning values)

catalog.empty: No catalog: statuses, roles and groups are free text.
catalog.applyHint: Apply rebuilds the modeler. Undo starts over afterwards.
catalog.idHint: Leave empty: the ID is derived from the name.

files.noFolder: Choose a folder for your models, e.g. on a network drive. Saving then writes directly to the file.
files.permission: After each restart the browser asks again whether bestbpmn may use the folder “{{folder}}”.
files.empty: There are no models (.bpmn) in the folder yet.
files.saveAsName: File name in the working folder:
